QuestInfo.name: Investigating the Jazz Bar
QuestInfo.0: Seems like Ryden has another mission for you.
QuestInfo.1: It's time to take a more aggressive stance on things. Ryden wants you to search the #bJazz Bar#k, while he lures the Dark Lord outside.
QuestInfo.2: You found the Dark Lord's Diary.

0.0: #h0#, are you ready for a new mission? It's time to take a more aggressive stance.

yes.0: I'd thought we had a tight lid on our operation, but it turns out the Dark Lord's been stealing our information. It's time to strike back.
yes.1: I'm going to lure the Dark Lord out of his little Jazz Bar den, and #byou'll sneak in and search the bar -- thoroughly -- for any information you can find.#k.

1.0: The Dark Lord's diary... This is perfect. Let's take a peek...

item.0: I can't distract him forever. Search the #bJazz Bar#k! It should be easy!
